prompt: We're running a headless research compute server (no desktop, no monitor) and need to get our team's note-taking system operational on it. The vault with all our research notes lives at `/root/research-vault`. We need the system fully set up so anyone on the team can run note commands from the terminal without worrying about display sessions or user permissions. Once everything is working, please produce a concise status report file named `obsidian_setup_report.md` in the workspace summarising what was installed, where the command shortcut lives, which vault is active, which commands were verified as working, and any known limitations. The setup scripts you need are already in the `scripts/` folder.
